title: A Hartman-Grobman Theorem for the Navier-Stokes Equation on $\mathbb T^3$
summary: We prove a local Hartman-Grobman theorem at zero for the unforced Navier-Stokes equation on the three-dimensional torus in the strong topology of $H^s$ for every $s>7/2$. More precisely, we construct a homeomorphism between open positively invariant neighborhoods of zero that conjugates the Navier-Stokes semiflow to the heat semigroup. We develop an infinite-dimensional boundary-time scheme built on a nested hierarchy of exact asymptotic dynamical factors.
